entries.name: Thrilla in Vanilla
entries.note: Toothsome menu confirms $19 shake = vanilla ice cream + vanilla pastry cream + vanilla wafers + macaron + whipped topping + cherry. No official nutrition; modeled as ~20oz premium vanilla shake (Sonic large vanilla ~930 cal/105g carbs analog) plus wafers/macaron/pastry cream toppings. Keyword 38g is a single-serving error; full shake as sold is ~130g carbs.

entries.name: Santa Hat Brownie Sundae
entries.note: DFB review (Plaza Ice Cream Parlor, $7.99, Very Merry Christmas Party): brownie + vanilla ice cream + hot fudge + crushed peppermint + whipped cream + red velvet cone with marshmallow; reviewers call it 'a lot'. Component build: brownie ~56g C, scoop ~30g C, fudge ~22g C, cone/peppermint/marshmallow ~20g C. Low end of prior range (60g) implausible for this build.

entries.name: Two Foot Dog
entries.note: Official description: 24-inch Vienna all-beef frankfurter on a baguette with 2 toppings ($20.99 base; fries are a separate combo upcharge, excluded here). Carbs driven by the ~24in baguette (~230g bread, ~117g carbs) + toppings; dog itself ~10oz all-beef frank (~810 cal, near-zero carbs). Sodium is genuinely extreme (frank + baguette).

entries.name: Whole Cheese Pizza
entries.note: Louie's/Cafe 4 menu: Whole Cheese Pizza $38.99 vs Jumbo Cheese Slice $11.29 — this is a full-size sharing pie (~16in, ~8 slices), NOT a personal pizza; prior 70-96g range is roughly one jumbo slice. Modeled on large NY-style cheese pie (Domino's large cheese 8x290 cal analog). Exact diameter not published, hence 45.

entries.name: Indian-Style Bread Service (with 3 accompaniments)
entries.note: Sanaa basket = 5 large flatbreads (traditional/garlic-ginger/spiced naan, onion kulcha, paneer paratha) — 'shareable between one and five people'; 3-accompaniment version is same breads with 3 dips (~2oz each, incl. sugary chutneys). Bread: 5 x ~90g naan (262 cal/45g carbs each per USDA-style data) + dips ~20g carbs. As sold for the table: ~230g carbs; prior 100g low end covers only ~2 breads.

entries.name: Chili Cheese Dog Combo
entries.note: Blondie's (Toon Lagoon) Chili Dog Combo $18.79: 'Foot long hot dog topped with chili cheese sauce and diced onions' + fries (platter includes fries; combo adds fountain drink, excluded here since zero-carb choices exist). Basis: Sonic Footlong Chili Cheese Coney published panel (830 cal/66g carb/51g fat/24g protein/2100mg Na) + ~5oz theme-park fries (~450 cal/55g carb). Decomposition's 120g matches; keyword 63g missed the fries.

entries.name: Rapunzel Sundae
entries.note: DFB/WDWNT reviews confirm components: shortcake base + lemon DOLE Whip + wild berry soft-serve swirl, berry compote, sugar flowers, whipped cream ($7.79 snack cup). Basis: ~1 cup soft serve (Dole Whip official 90 cal/22g carb per 1/2 cup → ~44g) + shortcake ~26g + compote ~15g + sugar flowers ~10g. Top of model range (68-95g) is correct; this is sugar-dense.

entries.name: Indian-Style Bread Service (with all 9 accompaniments)
entries.note: As sold = FIVE breads (traditional/garlic-ginger/spiced naan, onion kulcha, paneer paratha) + 9 dip ramekins; reviews call it 'almost a meal in itself' for 2-4. Basis: 5 x ~75-90g naan-class breads (~40-47g carb each per USDA/takeaway naan data) ~195-230g + 9 x ~2 tbsp chutneys/jams/hummus ~55-60g carb. Models' 120-160g treated it as a single-bread serving — systematic undercount.

entries.name: All Classic Dozen
entries.note: Sum of Voodoo's OFFICIAL per-doughnut nutrition (PDF effective 7/1/2025) over the published Classic Dozen composition (baker's dozen of 13, per Voodoo Toast ordering pages): Blueberry Cake, Buttermilk Bar, Glazed Old Fashioned, Raspberry Romeo, Sprinkle Cake, Powdered Sugar Cake, Plain Cake, Cinnamon Sugar Cake, Raised Glazed, Chocolate Ring, Chocolate Old Fashioned, Butterfingering, Maple Bar. Caloric math checks (4545 est vs 4500). Prior 45-53g was one doughnut, not the box.

entries.name: Whole Cheese Pizza
entries.note: Louie's Italian (USF) Whole Cheese Pizza $38.99 is a LARGE shared pie, not personal: reviewers state a 'jumbo slice' ($11.29) 'is honestly a quarter of a whole large pizza' → whole pie = 4 jumbo slices, ~16in. Basis: large-pizzeria cheese pie analog (Domino's 14in hand-tossed cheese whole = 2320 cal/272g carb, scaled x1.3 for 16in). Models' 70-96g was one jumbo slice, not the whole pie as sold.
